headline: Pakistan and Afghanistan agreed to an 'immediate ceasefire' at high-level Doha talks on Oct 18, ending 1+ week of border clashes
dek: Pakistan and Afghanistan agreed to an 'immediate ceasefire' at high-level Doha talks on Oct 18, ending 1+ week of border clashes (worst since 2021) after a 48-hour truce broke Friday. Talks mediated by Qatar AND Turkey.
sources: Qatar Ministry of Foreign Affairs statement; Pakistan Defence Minister Khawaja Asif (social post); Afghan spokesman Zabihullah Mujahid (X post)
fault_line: Truce or timeout? — a Doha ceasefire collapsed into Istanbul failure once before; does the Oct 25 round build a real verification mechanism, or just another handshake photo?
